actionable_sentences: The API name 'CancelRegistration' must be used exactly (case-insensitive) when constructing the API call.
A required parameter 'appointment_id' must be supplied as a string value representing the unique identifier of the appointment to be canceled.
The API response must include a 'status' field containing the outcome of the cancellation operation.
lifted_nl: The API call must use the exact string "CancelRegistration" (case-insensitively) as the operation identifier.
The request must include a parameter named "appointment_id" whose value is a string that uniquely identifies the appointment to be canceled.
The API response must contain a field called "status" that includes a value describing the outcome of the cancellation operation.
operations.LABEL: FUNCTIONAL_SPEC
operations.Precondition: appointment_id is a non-empty string and refers to an existing appointment record in the system.
operations.Postcondition: The API returns a status field with a value indicating the cancellation outcome (e.g., 'success' or 'cancelled').
assumptions: The system maintains records of appointments with unique IDs.
The CancelRegistration API is accessible and functional for the given appointment_id.
invariants: After a successful cancellation, the appointment is no longer active under the given appointment_id.
The returned status reflects the cancellation result.
